t: Enter Fractal, defeat the Archont of the Architects and prevent the opening of the Path.

Good job... The banner did work! Our guys were so encouraged.

Now we just have to capture this building and drive the Architects out - back to their world through that Path. We will seal that hole tightly! And destroy their Fractal, if we have to.

Are you ready, soldiers? Let's go then!
Attack! Today we will be victorious!

So, this is the end of the Path. But is this the end of war? The Architect was defeated, but wasn't destroyed. Trouble seems to persist - Chaos, Order, Architects, Demons, fanatics - what do we do with them all?!

War after war, catastrophe after catastrophe. It makes me feel sometimes that the Order wouldn't be so bad after all. We're going round in a vicious circle. And I will do my best to find the way to break it!
Enter Fractal, defeat the Archont of the Architects and prevent the opening of the Path.

Good job... The banner did work! Our guys were so encouraged.

Now we just have to capture this building and drive the Architects out - back to their world through that Path. We will seal that hole tightly! And destroy their Fractal, if we have to.

Are you ready, soldiers? Let's go then!

So, this is the end of the Path. But is this the end of war? The Architect was defeated, but wasn't destroyed. Trouble seems to persist - Chaos, Order, Architects, Demons, fanatics - what do we do with them all?!

War after war, catastrophe after catastrophe. It makes me feel sometimes that the Order wouldn't be so bad after all. We're going round in a vicious circle. And I will do my best to find the way to break it!
Collect 20 pieces of Refined Iron Ore to Sigurd the Swindler.

Oh, woe is me! With my mine out of commission, I've got no income! And with no income, I've got no way to pay and feed my workers! I have an idea! If you would be so kind as to gather me some iron ore, then I could make enough money to feed my boys for a week! Oh, please! You can't imagine how much it would help - I know how to make a profit out of the most mundane resources!
So, do you have the iron ore?
Wonderful! There's enough here to trade for an entire feast!
Speak with Elizaveta Rysina, Head of the City Council, about Tensess' message.

Join forces with the League? I doubt even Nezeb himself would risk introducing such a radical policy on our foreign relations!
Look, even if we suppose that Tensess is right and that the demonic threat has not been neutralized, I can't just up and cease the war with the League without the Empire facing severe ramifications. It would take years just to make the Imperial citizens stop believing in Nezeb's and Skrakan's sacrifice during the Great Astral Campaign. The League is our enemy, and the demons don't seem nearly as bad or dangerous enough to displace it.
No, it's downright impossible! Especially considering that we have no reason to believe Tensess' groundless words! That's right - groundless! It's probably just the demon worshippers acting up locally. And any potentially dangerous consequences of their activity has already been prevented by you!
Still, we shouldn't ignore this signal completely. I suppose the City Council should investigate the matter. Speak to Elizaveta Rysina. Have her reference this data against the information we already have on the demon worshippers. Perhaps there'll be a connection...

Hmm... The security of the Empire demands that we be vigilant, even if we're talking about ravings of a late Great Mage.
It should be noted that we receive regular reports of demons and cultists activities. However, most of those are fueled by old fears and ignorance, and we would waste time investigating them.
Meet with Sigurd the Swindler in Swindlerville on Coldberg.

We have a letter here that requires our immediate attention.
A Free Trader, Sigurd the Swindler, tells us that demons have appeared on Coldberg. At first glance, it just looks like another scream from a frightened, stupid Gibberling. But the circumstances of this matter became more serious...
First of all, they say that this Sigurd is one of the Oligarchs, a member of the Council of Seven that rules those rebellious Free Traders. Is it the truth? I haven't got a clue. The Council of Seven is one of those unsolved mysteries. Maybe it's all hogwash... but the Council should check everything, even the absurd.
Secondly, that Swindler is one of the meteorite ore suppliers... We can't lose him.
And third, not long ago Swindler asked the ZIT to help with the same problem. And without even asking us, Nomarkh Nynetjer took several scientists with him to Coldberg on a mission! And we haven't heard anything from them since!
So, the time has come to send our wisest and most talented agent to Coldberg. You will go meet with Sigurd the Swindler at once.

Aha, the Empire finally decided to do something! Of course, everybody needs meteorite ore. I'm sure the Nezebgrad City Council would just rather spit on me and my allod... but they need me.
You're just in time, I had already called for the Demon Hunters, the Trinity Church, and the ZIT scientists, and they're all useless!
Deliver Sigurd the Swindler's letter to Elizaveta Rysina in Nezebgrad.

The Broderen Mine has finally been cleared of those nasty skeletons! Now the miners can go back underground, the shipments of ore will resume, and money will once again start trickling my way! Hurray!
I can't believe things are getting back to normal. Well, I guess we still need to deal with those Astral fangs... But at least the mine is resuming operation!
Everything is working out just fine! Here, I've prepared this letter for Elizaveta Rysina, requesting that she award you for your efforts. Don't forget to give her the letter when you see her!

A letter of gratitude from the Swindler? Let's read it!
He requests that you be rewarded. Hmm, just yesterday I received a report from Nomarkh Nynetjer, in which he also makes note of your accomplishments. But I still don't understand why he chose to withdraw the expedition from Coldberg. Ugh, those silly scientists always think that our City Council is behind everything that goes on in the world! Oh well, that doesn't matter anymore. What matters is that Coldberg has been cleared of the undead and meteorite ore shipments have resumed!
Still, it's too early to celebrate! This business with the Astral fangs and the Orcish necromancer calls for a separate investigation!
Find the 4 stones in Swindlerville, Frost Peak, Snowy Wastes, and the Ruined Shore. Report back to Anthropologist Sagehoof the Insightful in Swindlerville.

You say you know Coldberg, but I don't believe you. If you want to prove to me that you know what you're talking about, then you'll need to tell me where the hidden stones are.
What's that? You don't know? Well, then I guess you don't know as much as you thought you did. But don't worry, that's what I'm here for!
If you can go out and find the four stones hidden around Coldberg, then I'll teach you everything that you need to know! Don't worry. They're easy to find. Here, I'll even give you a little hint. You can find them around Swindlerville, Frost Peak, Snowy Wastes, and the Ruined Shore.
What are you waiting for? I won't teach you anything until you can tell me where those stones are!
Good job, I knew you'd be fine. Some people just can't do it, though. You didn't happen to see any frozen bodies out there, did you?
Collect 5 Coldberg Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Sagehoof the Insightful in Swindlerville.

I know you're a seasoned traveler, but Coldberg is a very dangerous place!
You let your guard down for one second and that's it! It's all over! I want you to get used to the dangers of a place like this, so I need you to venture out and kill 5 of Coldberg's most dangerous creatures!
But you need to give me proof – a trophy from the likes of Frostrage, Milcake, Drafty Elemental, Shurko, or Kroto Slimetooth.
Well? Have those creatures been defeated?

Excellent!
I knew you could do it. And by defeating these beasts, you now know more about the local fauna.
Kill 100 mountainfolk while on Coldberg and report back to Anthropologist Sagehoof the Insightful in Swindlerville.

The next thing that you need to learn about is Coldberg's local troublemakers.
No, not the demons and skeletons. Those pests are not local to this allod. I'm talking about the mountainfolk.
Those little bastards are always trying to steal our goods and equipment! We have enough trouble just getting those good out here! We can't have them up and taking it! Go out and show those punks who the real masters of this allod are.
Well? I hope those mountainfolk shake with fear every time they hear your name.

Thank you.
Hopefully now we can focus on getting rid of those other pests – the demons and the skeletons!
Gather 7 Pristine Reindeer Moss bundles for Anthropologist Sagehoof the Insightful in Swindlerville.

There are a lot of valuable resources here on Coldberg, but only one stands out - apart from the meteorite ore, of course. I'm talking about reindeer moss!
What? Don't laugh! It's good for your health! For everyone's health! If you eat just a bit of it, it will keep you from getting sick! It only grows here, you know.
Please go out and collect some for me. You can find it all over Coldberg. I plan on cultivating this more extensively so that it can be distributed to people all over Sarnaut.
Reindeer moss grows all over Coldberg but it's small, so you'll have to look carefully.

Thank you!
Now our warriors are sure to be tough enough to take on the demons!
Complete all of Sagehoof the Insightful's tasks and report back to him in Swindlerville.

If you can successfully complete all my tasks, you'll be generously rewarded.
And I'm not talking about some rinky-dink potion! You'll have the knowledge that you've gained from this adventure as well as some prime equipment that's bound to help you on your future journeys!
So, find the stones, defeat the beasts, and gather some valuable resources here in Coldberg!
Have you completed all of my tasks?

Wonderful!
You know, I must admit, I thought you wouldn't be able to do that. That you for proving me wrong! Go ahead and take your reward!
Kill 6 Bears on the north-eastern island of Coldberg. Report back to the Guarded Family in Swindlerville.

We are great bear hunters! Sigurd even shipped us in all the way from Frozen Frontier to take care of the polar bears here!
...But we haven't been able to kill a single one.
The bears here a lot tougher than any of the other bears we've fought on Frozen Frontier. And they're a lot smarter too! Have you even seen a pack this big?! They know that there's safety in numbers!
We need your help! Our reputation is on the line! Please!

Thank you, thank you, thank you!
You have no idea what this means to us!
Speak with Marianne de Ardeur, the High Prioress, about Tensess' message.

"Join forces with the Empire and strike a collective blow against the demons." Oh, if only it were so easy!
I don't want to bore you with a history lecture, but I will say this - even the most ignorant peasant on Umoira knows that during the Great Astral Campaign, Skrakan and Nezeb sacrificed themselves to close the June Gates. And ever since that day, the allods have been rid of the threat of demon invasion.
I think that Tensess is exaggerating when he says that history may repeat itself. I bet it's all just some petty cultists' plot...
That said, we cannot just ignore the words of a Great Mage, even one who's left us. Go and speak to Marianne de Ardeur. If anyone can settle the matter of the demons, it's the Church of Light!

Oh great Light, how am I supposed to react to that!? On one hand, the great Tensess has ordered us to join forces with the Empire to fight the demons... On the other hand, every citizen of the League knows that the Empire is our sworn enemy, while the demons have long since gone!
So who am I to believe!? The great Tensess, the founder of the Church of Light... or history itself!? I'm so confused! What should I do?
Meet with Sigurd the Swindler on Coldberg.

We need to find out what's happening - to either refute the words of Tensess or to corroborate them. Fortunately, I know just where to begin.

Recently, we received a distress signal from the allod of Coldberg. The author of the letter is Sigurd the Swindler - a Free Trader and one of our main suppliers of meteorite ore. Some even say he's one of the Oligarchs.

Who are the Oligarchs? Rumor has it that the actions of the Free Traders are actually governed by the Council of Seven that is comprised of the wealthiest and most powerful Free Traders. It's an old myth, though, and it's probably just another conspiracy theory. Anyway, Sigurd writes that his allod has been attacked by demons! He says that if we don't help, the shipments of meteorite ore will stop and he'll have no choice but to flee the allod.

As you can probably understand, we cannot afford to risk losing our supply of meteorite ore. I've already dispatched some priests of the Church of Light to Coldberg, but there's been no word from them yet.

This worries me! You are to follow them and find out what's happening over there. May the Light be with you!

Good to see the League finally fork over some reinforcements! Nobody wants to risk losing shipments of meteorite ore! Just in time, too! I was already beginning to gather up my things. I've already called for the Demon Hunters, the Church of Light, and the ZIT scientists... and they're all useless!
Deliver Sigurd the Swindler's letter to Marianne de Ardeur in Novograd.

The Broderen Mine has finally been cleared of those nasty skeletons! Now the miners can go back underground, the shipments of ore will resume, and money will once again start trickling my way! Hurray!
I can't believe things are getting back to normal. Well, I guess we still need to deal with those Astral fangs... But at least the mine is resuming operation!
Everything is working out just fine! Here, I've prepared this letter for Marianne de Ardeur, requesting that she award you for your efforts. Don't forget to give her the letter when you see her!

A letter from Sigurd? Let's see what he wrote! Alright, he thanks you for your assistance rendered, and promises to increase shipments of ore to compensate for the losses suffered during downtime!
I guess this means that you were able to save the mine and allod from complete destruction? This is wonderful news! But, unfortunately, this joy is marred by the other things that have been happening these past few days.
Strizhov has come back, and it should be noted that the events on Coldberg have greatly affected his... hmm... his stability. He just keeps going on and on about demons, sowing discord among the clergy and the congregation! I was forced to order his excommunication.
But that doesn't mean we're letting this go, oh no! The matter demands an immediate and highly thorough investigation! We must get to the bottom of the Astral fangs and this strange Orcish woman that has joined the demon worshippers!
Dig around the Astral fang for treasure.
What's this giant thing stuck in the snow? Something must surely be hidden here.
Oh! It's the buried treasure! That old loudmouth in Swindlerville wasn't lying after all!
Explore Coldberg to find the stolen chest. Report back to Vlad Gergiev in Swindlerville.

Frost Peak...
The tallest mountain in the north-west of Coldberg. I used to dream of climbing it, seeing the island from up there... But I'm always busy... There's a lot of work to do. And now there's no time for that, as you can see.
Maybe you'd like to do it. Why? Because there's treasure.
That got your attention, I see! Let me tell you a story.
When I started working here, I found the notes of my predecessor. He mentioned a valuable chest that went missing. Suspicion fell on the miners who were working for him at the time. The miners denied everything and eventually quit altogether. The chest was never found. But the notes said the miners took their most valuable things to the Frost Peak, offering them to some deity of theirs. So if they did steal the chest, I reckon it should be there. But maybe not!
You can look for it if you want.
Come on! I know you can find it! If not, then no one can!
Aha! See, what'd I tell you? I knew you could find it!
Find 3 pieces of Meteorite Ore and bring them to Yaver Nakhtmin.

The Suppliers' Guild sends its greetings!
Yes, the Suppliers' Guild is even all the way out here! Coldberg is a very important allod to us as it's a place where meteorite is mined. This is a very important strategic resource! My orders are to prevent the League from stealing our shipments of meteorite ore. They'll try to say that we have no claims to it, but we have all kinds of documents signed by Sigurd himself!
It is our ore! Unfortunately, Sigurd has become greedy since this whole Astral Fang issue and he's trying to force us to battle with the League over our rightful ore! I believe he is trying to create delays until he can get his mine running again.
However I, for one, will not sit around while he decides to send our ore to Nezebgrad! Now I want you to go sneak into his cargo hold, take three pieces of our meteorite ore, and bring them back to me. His mercenaries might try to give you a hard time, but I know that you can handle it.
Please hurry!
I'll give you a supplier's badge every time you bring me three more pieces of meteorite ore.
Excellent. Thanks to your help, we'll soon have all our ore back in Imperial hands!
Collect 6 Supplier's Badges for Yaver Nakhtmin.

You want to know what to do with the badges?
Then listen up.
Collect six badges and bring them to me. Ten badges! Now that's an accomplishment! That means you serve your country well. And you deserve a reward.
Got it? I'll be waiting for six badges.
Six badges a day - that's it. Don't bring more than that - I don't have enough rewards.
You brought me ten? Okay, here's your reward that's better than a badge...
No ship will fly without a meteorite.
Find 3 pieces of Meteorite Ore and bring them to Velimir Vishnev.

Do you think it's easy to be a supplier? My friends say that they envy me when I tell them about my profession. They think it's the best job in the world, but they don't know what kind of problems I need to get involved in sometimes!
Take this current situation for example - according to the contract that both Sigurd and I signed, Sigurd should be sending meteorite ore to Novograd. But he hasn't done it!
He says that once this situation with demons and undead is solved, he'll finally send it out! Doesn't he know how important the meteorite ore is?! Our ships won't be able to enter the Astral without it! And worse yet, I'll be punished for breaking our supply deadlines!
This is such a disaster! We'll be sure to avoid dealing with Sigurd in the future! But can you help me? The ore is in boxes on his cargo dock. I'm sure he has his men guarding it, but I just need three pieces. Please help! The League needs that ore!
I'll give you a contractor's badge every time you bring me three more pieces of meteorite ore.
Wonderful! And here is the reward that I promised – a contractor's badge!
Collect 6 Contractor's Badges for Velimir Vishnev.

Let me tell you about contractor's badges.
If you help me get meteorite iron fragments, you will receive them as a reward.
Once you collect six pieces, bring them to me. I'll give you a special reward: a very useful potion. From my personal stash.
Got it? I'll be waiting.

You can exchange six badges for a reward once a day. Only once!
Or I'll run out of rewards.
Thank you. I'm so glad that Novograd will now have ore, even it is just a few pieces at a time.
Meteorite is rare nowadays. Supply from Coldberg must be uninterrupted.
Check on 4 Crates of Meteorite Ore for Sigurd the Swindler.

The other day, an entire army of the undead appeared on Coldberg and captured the Broderen Mine! The workers ran from their posts in a panic and many were killed. The undead now occupy the mine. I don't know what they're up to in there, but ever since then, the ground surrounding the mine has begun to swell and fracture. The allod itself is beginning to break into several pieces!
At least my trade post is still in one piece... For now! I was hoping that the Demon Hunters could drive away the undead, but unfortunately, they're useless against them. The undead just aren't their field, they say!
Listen, just before the attack my workers had just finished preparing a new batch of ore for shipment. It's still scattered around out there, right outside the mine. Please, go find the crates and check on my ore!
Our delivery schedule has been disrupted and these crates won't help to solve the problem... But then again, neither will losing them! Did you find the crates? I hope the ore is all right!

What do you mean the ore isn't in the crates? Could the undead have stolen it?! Or destroyed it?! But why? I guess I could see why demons might want to, being scared of meteorite and all... But... How terrible.
Speak with Kurgan the Crafty about bonding the Gibberlings into a Sprout.

Everyone knows that the Empire is the enemy of the Gibberlings! They never miss an opportunity to oppress and enslave us, but this Swindler character still thinks it's okay to sell Imperial troops our meteorite ore.
I heard that his brothers died in the Astral... Maybe that's why he's always so greedy and spiteful? But hey, I lost my brothers in the attack on the mine, and look at me! I'm not about to stoop to Swindler's level!
So I had this idea - how about the three of us join forces? Me, Swindler, and Fitilek! Then it'll be just like being in a full Sprout again! But it's easier said than done... We'll need magic. There are no Gibberling sages on the allod, but we do have an Orcish shaman. I'm sure he'll be able to help. Talk to him for us please!

Help the Gibberlings? Hell, why not! As you can see, I'm not exactly beating off customers with a stick. Orcish shamans have been dishonored among their kind, so no one likes us.
Anyhow, there is a ritual that fits the bill - the Brotherhood of Blood Ritual. It's not very popular nowadays, seeing as there aren't many willing to bind themselves in the bonds of the brotherhood. These bonds are stronger than even those of wedlock - once taken, they can never be escaped. But know that this service isn't cheap!
Speak with Kurgan the Crafty about the Ritual of Spirit Power.

I don't want to live anymore!
When the undead attacked the mine, who was there, beating 'em down first? You guessed it - I crushed their rotten skulls and bones! But there were just too many of 'em and I got scared! I threw down my weapon and I ran.
I ain't a warrior anymore, I ain't an Orc! I'm nobody now! We've always tried to stay clear of the shamans. The shamans rely on cheap tricks and lies - they ain't real warriors! But now, my only hope is to speak to a shaman. They could perform the Ritual of Spirit Power that would rid me of this dishonor.
Luckily, there's a shaman on this allod that can help. His name is Kurgan the Crafty. Please, speak with him and ask him to help me... Please!

I will help the Orc! For years the Orcs have turned to the shamans for help. We've healed their wounds, exorcised evil spirits, enchanted their weapons, and cursed their enemies! Even now, when my sister needs my help, I cannot refuse!
There is an ancient ritual, the Call of the Spirits, it should restore her self-confidence. But of course, there is a fee for my services...
Use the Shaman's Amulet to collect 6 Lynx Souls for Kurgan the Crafty.

I don't have any assistants here on Coldberg. No one likes us shamans... But I've already told you that!
Anyway, how about we trade favors? To properly conduct my ritual, I'll need lynx souls. Not Sparks, but souls! Do you know the difference? No? I don't either... Maybe it's all the same. But I call a spade a spade, and all this newfangled talk about Sparks, Tensess, Nezeb and Skrakan - I don't give a hoot about all that!
Lynx souls are best suited for my purposes. They are perfect for this! Not too many - six will do. I already have a few! If you help me out, I will gladly return the favor and help you with whatever issues you need assistance with.
Here, I'll give you a special amulet. When you kill a lynx, use the amulet over the body. It will capture the soul.
Where are my souls? I'm still waiting on you to fill up the amulet. Trust me, it's very important!

You have the souls? Six? Yep, that will do!
This allod isn't that big, but I still can't explore it alone. There are just too many dangerous beasts on Coldberg nowadays. There are spots that even the Demon Hunters avoid... And those guys have seen things I can't even imagine! What is it I seek, you ask? You'll find out soon. Very soon.
Find a Box of Weapons, a Box of Clothes, a Box of Alcohol, a Box of Provisions, and a Box of Tools for Vlad Gergiev.

You know, we're completely dependent on regular shipments of supplies here on Coldberg. It's no wonder, really, since the only thing that's useful around here is meteorite ore. We get everything from other allods - food, weapons, tools, you name it... But we have a problem. The last shipment never made it to us.
Our beloved "Spirit" was attacked and by an Astral demon and shattered on the shore. By the time the Demon Hunters came the ship was already in pieces, the demon was gone, and the provisions were scattered throughout the Astral.
Luckily, a few boxes washed up on the southern shore. Please go find them and bring me back five boxes. They should contain tools, clothes, provisions, alcohol, and weapons.
We need to collect these crates before the mountainfolk get to them. We haven't exactly been getting along with them lately...

Let's see what we've got here... Some of Nezebgrad's best vodka, sabertooth squirrel hats, new blades, salted pork, and a bunch of mining tools... These will come in handy when we take the mine back from the undead!
We also ordered a whole crate of turnip paste, but I guess the demon already made a snack out of it. Damn that monster!
Thanks for your help. The next shipment is coming in two weeks so we would be in a lot of trouble without these crates!
Kill 6 Mountainfolk Warriors and Barlas the Shortlegged. Report back to Sevek the Savage in Swindlerville.

Those stumpies need to get what's coming to them! South of here, up in the mountains, is a mountainfolk settlement. Not too long ago, we were out mining for meteorite in that area and we had a few run-ins with the shorties.
Our engineers later informed us that there was no ore to be had, so we put an end to the fighting and entered into a truce with the mountainfolk. We promptly forgot about their very existence.
We recently remembered them quite suddenly when a whole throng of them suddenly decided to attack the mine! We fought them off, of course, but the little bastards need to be taught a lesson!
Kill a dozen or so of them... and don't forget their leader, Barlas the Shortlegged! Show them what they get for messing with us! We can't deal with this distraction while we have the demons to neutralize.
What's happening with those mountainfolk? Damnit, had we known about their attack ahead of time, we'd have made sure to give them a proper welcome!

You did it! Hmm, I wonder why those mountainfolk starting acting up in the first place? To be honest, I'd rather avoid any further conflicts with them.
They're not great fighters, but they know every inch of these mountains by heart and they're pretty good at setting traps. I've already lost three of my best Orc mercenaries in these mountains!
Kill 6 Skeletal Enchanters or 6 Skeletal Skulllreavers for Sevek the Savage.

As you may already know, our mine has been overtaken by the undead. Those bony bastards are holed up in there, waiting for easy pickings. What's worse, the undead have taken to paying us visits whenever the mood takes them. That's why we're always on our toes!
I figure we might as well fight back - hit the mine and put a dent in the undead population. There are two different kinds of them hanging around the mine. I want you to go in and kill eight of each kind.
Don't actually go inside the mine - the skeletons in there are really tough. I've lost so many men thanks to those monsters. Some scumbag necromancer recently resurrected my dead men too, and they're out here wandering among the rest of the filthy undead. We'll eventually end this threat entirely, but for now let's focus on the immediate problem.
How are things going in the mine? How many undead have you killed?

I hope that it takes the undead a good long while to recover from your exploits! But the strange thing is, they refill their ranks pretty fast, and for the life of me I cannot understand how! We've explored this allod very thoroughly and there are no large cemeteries anywhere, so where are all those undead coming from?!
Collect 6 Rotten Skulls in Broderen Mine and return to Yaver Anysis in Swindlerville.

I've got a whole bundle of resignation letters here! Boss will kill me!
A good chunk of our workers died when the undead launched their initial assault on the mine. Those that survived have either walked out on their contract or are about to do so. Many of the workers sailed away on the last ship... and we probably won't be getting replacements any time soon thanks to the rumor mill's hard work. At this point everyone knows that Coldberg's been overtaken by the undead.
I hope we'll take back the mine in the near future. But who will work there if everyone quits? We need to reassure our workers that they won't get eaten on their next shift! Kill six skeletons around the mine and bring me their rotten skulls. I want the workers to see that we can ensure their safety!
Where are those skulls? It's very important that we instill a bit of confidence into the workers for the future!

Excellent! I'll set these up on a special stand. Nothing beats having some inspiration like that!
Let's hope this cuts down on the number of workers leaving the allod. You know, they won't find better working conditions anywhere on Sarnaut. A competitive salary, disability benefits, paid vacations...
Sigurd sure knows how to treat his workers. Actually, things were going just great before the rumors started to spread out. I wish I knew who does it so I could punish them!
Kill 6 Malicious Demon Scouts and report back to Nikolai Strizhov.

If not for meteorite ore, this Swindler would've been euthanized a long time ago. Not only does he trade with the Empire, but he also dares to put forth heretical theories!
The doctrine of the Church of Light clearly states that the demon invasion was over with when Nezeb and Tensess closed the June Gates. Whatever demons show up here are unorganized vagrants. Therefore, any notion of a "conspiracy" is complete and utter nonsense!
There's been talk of a schism in the Church of Light recently, and it's all because of these demons! I swear that I will do all I can do put an end to it! As punishment for spreading panic and rumors I hereby sentence you to penance! There are demon scouts wandering around nearby - go kill eight of them and repent!
I will not remove your penance until the demon scouts are destroyed. Keep trying, my child, and complete your mission!

As you can see, my penance proved incredibly useful! These scouts are crawling out of the Astral - looking, sniffing for something! That doesn't mean we should jump to conclusions, though - a dozen demons aren't particularly dangerous.
We must remain faithful and stay calm. We even have a chapel here so you can pray to your heart's content! You know... they say that Tensess himself visited this land. That means it's our sacred duty to cleanse it of demons and the undead!
Sanctify 5 Astral Fangs and return to Rada Likhareva.

Strizhov sent me here to sanctify the shore... Those Astral fangs have been chewing on it for a while now.
I've already used holy water to try to halt their advancement, but it didn't seem to work very well. It could be that it's not the ground that needs to be sanctified, but the Astral fangs themselves. Take this holy water and sprinkle it on five Astral fangs. Oh, I can't wait to see what happens!
I hope that the holy water will help us out of this predicament. We need to stop these Astral fangs, lest they devour the allod faster than a rat chews up a piece of bread.

What? Something worse than the Astral fangs? The demons were followed by the undead!? That's the worst news I've heard since being assigned to this wretched allod!
This means that those fear mongers were right all along. The demons aren't just wandering the allod for no reason. No, they're planning another invasion and this time, they're bringing allies - the undead! I only hope that Strizhov will believe us!
Kill 6 demons and report back to Nikolai Strizhov.

Nikolai Strizhov is going to demand proof, and if we can't provide it, he's going to impose another penalty! He's been dishing them out left and right, trying to prevent dissent.
So I have this idea... There's always a bunch of demons roaming around the Astral Fangs near the mine. Go and kill six demons. If there's any undead nearby, they will surely show up! I know it's dangerous, but we must do this to uncover the truth!
Once you're done, report to Strizhov. We'll see what he says!
They're angry with me over the penances. They're calling me a tyrant! But the Church of Light must avoid a schism at all costs! A schism is far more dangerous than any demon!

So the demons and the undead are working together... Could I have been wrong all along? How am I going to look into the eyes of my brothers and sisters? Especially after all those penances I imposed on them for heresy!
Kill 6 Icy Ogres and return to Deyvson the Wily.

There's a group of ogres living to the south of here. We've been fighting them for what seems like ages, but we haven't been able to root them out completely just yet. The bastards are really fertile! They're worse than rabbits!
They used to carry out regular raids on the mine, making off with our workers. Now that the mine is full of nothing but those boney undead, the ogres have been slipping into hunger-induced rages.
I'm expecting them to storm up here looking for food any day now. We must make a preemptive blow! Get over there and send no less than a dozen into the Astral!
Those ogres' heads are as empty as their cauldrons! There's only one thing on their minds and that's grub! Tell me, did they get what was coming to them?

They'll think twice before attacking anyone on this allod now! And if you beat them again and again, the Traders will respect you more, too! Double profit, see?
Now, how about killing some more ogres?
Investigate the Ogre Camp in the Snowy Wastes.

We monitor all demonic activity on this allod and we're striving to scout every inch! Unfortunately, we're having trouble with the ogre camp.
Ogres are gracious hosts, always so eager to welcome everyone into their homes... But if only they'd allow their guests to leave! Go investigate what's happening near their camp. We need to leave no corner unturned!

Hmm...The corpse is still fresh. The demon looks to have been killed by a blunt object, probably a club. He probably came to offer the ogres an alliance but got cracked over the head instead. The savages even cut off a piece of his flesh, but it doesn't look like they liked the taste very much.
Inform Nikolai Strizhov the ogres' fight with the demons.

It looks like those dimwitted and primitive ogres managed to best a demon, while the League's Church is barely keeping afloat in a fight against heretics.
This needs to be brought up to Strizhov. Then if he insists on continuing with his penances... Well, then that's his loss!

So it was the ogres that killed the demon!? They probably just got lucky... Listen, the last thing we want is rumors that the Church of Light has taken a backseat in the fight against demons. The fact is that we could offer a far more successful opposition to these monsters if our priests would just show a bit of sense and stop pushing the Church toward a schism!
Speak to Sigurd the Swindler in Swindlerville.

It looks like I was wrong after all! Tep and his cultists have no connection to what's been happening on Coldberg. This is the handiwork of a powerful necromancer, and judging by the Xadaganian ship, he's an Imperial citizen. The whole thing looks to be an alliance between him and the demons, which means that unless we stop them, there won't be much left of this allod left before long.
You may tell Sigurd the Swindler that we're willing to help him clear the mine of the undead!

Nizamar promised to help and now he's packing his bags! What, you think he's taking off because he's frightened by the undead? Think again! Our precious scientist is scared witless of the City Council. As soon as he found out that the ship came from the Empire, he damn near lost it, convinced that it's the City Council trying to nab my mine. And he's not about to go toe to toe with Rysina.
That's why he didn't send any help. But he did give us this device – it's an undead controller. Here's what the manual says - "Suppresses the will of the undead, renders them obedient for a short time." I wonder if this gift really works...
Use the Anti-Demon 2M on 6 Skeletal Lookouts before killing them, then report back to Timur Belinsky.

Greetings! I'm Timur Belinsky, the leader of the hunter expedition on Coldberg. What can I do for you?
So Sigurd thinks the demons are in cahoots with the undead? Can't say I'm surprised - after some discussion, we've come to the same conclusion.
Actually, my theory is that this is a new kind of undead... Perhaps demons created these new assistants... I've taken to calling them the Astral Undead.
Since you are helping Sigurd, maybe you can help us. I want to see if our old weapons are still effective against them. Here, take this! It's called "Anti-Demon 2M" and it's great at scaring off astral vermin. There's a whole horde of undead roaming around Frost Peak. Try using the repellent on them and kill six undead. If they're really Astral in nature, they'll be scampering away from you. That means you might need to do some running!
If I'm right about the undead being Astral in origin, then this repellent will make them run away as fast as those rickety little legs will carry them! So, what were are the results?

It didn't work? That's odd. Maybe the repellent was used up? No, that can't be, we just brought a new shipment from Kirah and I tested it myself on demons just the other day. It seems the device works wonder on demons, but it's ineffective against undead.
Turns out I was wrong - the demons have nothing to do with the undead invasion. Well then, who does? We must get to the bottom of this!
Collect 6 Ice Shards for Mila Tselikova.

I've seen my share of the undead while serving in the League's fleet. A tough job, too – not everyone can handle it!
Anyway, this one time we were looking for Ermolai, the pioneer, and we ended up in Siveria. There were plenty of undead, but we were managing just fine thanks to magic. We extracted ice shards from the elementals and used them to strike down the monsters! I bet we could try the same tactic here. The local elementals are even more powerful than their icy counterparts in Siveria. Go kill them and collect their shards for me. Six should be enough.
It was just as cold in Siveria as it is here. Maybe even colder! So, where are the ice shards? It's not that hard to beat it out of those elementals, you know.

These should work perfectly. Without these I doubt we would have ever made it out of Siveria alive. That place is full of Zem burial grounds. The moment your ship pulls ashore, it's already surrounded by a horde of undead!
Find the Gruff Family at the Frost Peak.

Did you see the Gibberlings around? Tiny, fluffy, heavily armed kids... I cannot find them anywhere.
I'm pretty sure they've gone hunting again. They never ask for permission! Oh, they'll be punished when they return, I promise!
If you meet, tell them I'll find those naughty little beggars anyway!
Mila Tselikova blustered to punish us? Hah! That's all she really can!
Collect 6 Bloody Yak Hearts and a Large Yak Heart for the Gruff Family.

Just look at those filthy demons gathering in the Astral... They're definitely up to something.
How about we have ourselves a little fun? The Demon Hunters have this old game we call "Astral fishing". To play the game, you simply place some bait on the shore and wait for an Astral demon to bite! For bait, we use the hearts of whatever animals are nearby - the demons can smell blood from great distances and will come running. The closest animals we can get bait from are the yaks. That means that your mission is to collect some yak hearts - about eight should do! After you're done, see if you can kill an old bull named Frosthoof and take his heart as well. We'll run a little experiment and see if his heart will land us the big one!
Where are the yak hearts? We can't wait to start catching us some demons! This is the best fishing spot that we've ever seen!

They'll swallow the bait whole, you just wait and see! Demons are remarkably vicious creatures. Their ultimate goal is destroying us all, so you've got to be out of your damn mind to ally yourself with them!
Place the Bloody Yak Hearts near the Astral Fangs and kill 3 Cursed Predators for the Gruff Family.

Now this is the funny part! Take the hearts and lay them out by the Astral fangs. When a demon comes over to check them out, you take it down!
The beasts get so crazy over the scent of fresh blood that they won't run back to safety even when they finally realize they've been ambushed. Lure out and kill three demons, then return to us.
Demons swarm to blood like flies to honey. Teasing them isn't the safest pastime, which is why Belinsky typically doesn't permit us to fish. So, how many demons did you kill?

See, you're doing great! This isn't your typical fishing trip - an excuse to "booze all day long!" Here you actually need a bit of know-how, alertness and agility.
The other day, two other guys and I were clobbering away at this one beast while it just kept on licking up the blood and paying us no heed. It was actually kind of insulting!
Place the Large Yak Heart near the Astral Fangs and kill Shirikaz the Accursed for the Gruff Family.

See? Didn't we tell you? It's a great fishing spot! Now let's try and use Frosthoof's heart as bait! It's got its own unique energy and smell, so it might attract a unique kind of creature as well. In fact, we're sure it will!
Go on, don't be shy - go set it out over by the Astral Fangs! We're sure you'll be able to deal with anything that appears. And if you can't, well... we're right behind you!
We love to experiment with different types of bait. Go lure out a demon and have at it! Good times!

Whoa, that was quite a monster! We've never seen one like that before. We dread to think of what other beasts may lurk in the Astral. Let's wrap up our fishing activities for today - who knows what else might turn up!
Meet with Timur Belinsky near Frost Peak.

What kind of demon was that? We've never seen one like it before, neither in life nor in textbooks. This must be some new kind of species... You need to report to Timur Belinsky at once!
Don't worry - he won't scold you for our little fishing trip once he sees what you've reeled in! But what about us? Well, we'll wait for you back here, just in case...

A new species of demon, you say? That can't be good. We've already got our hands full with the old ones. I'll tell the Gruff Family to put together a detailed description and circulate it throughout our posts and patrol ships.
Throughout our years of hunting Astral creatures we've seen and studied virtually every kind of demon... Where could this new demon have come from?
Speak to Sigurd the Swindler in Swindlerville.

Blast it! My findings couldn't be more wrong! The undead have zero reaction to the repellent and the artifact. That makes them nothing but ordinary undead. Do you realize what this means!?
We don't have a Great Mage on Coldberg, so that means that the only thing that's preventing the Astral from devouring this allod is the meteorite ore in the mine! The demons fear it, but your typical undead isn't phased by the meteorite, so they could easily destroy it all. Then the allod will be no more!
Go tell Sigurd that the Demon Hunters will help him clear out the mine! They might not be related to the demons, but we cannot let the allod be destroyed!

I thought that the Demon Hunters would come to my aid like they promised! Instead they sent me this lame potion to fight the demons. It has a warning label that read - "Keep away from children. Store away from fire or flame. In case of skin contact, wash thoroughly and contact a physician." What the heck!
Oh, and they included a letter saying that the allod is being attacked by demons, which is why they can't send anyone to help clear the mine! They don't want to scatter their resources! Imagine that! If that mine is going to be cleared, I'll need someone else to do it!
Collect 6 Bones from the undead for Nomarkh Nynetjer.

The Demon Hunters and the Church of Light are wasting their time! I am absolutely certain that the masterminds behind the events on Coldberg are none other than the Tep cultists.
Just think about it - who else but those damned cultists could have learned such impressive skills in necromancy? They can certainly handle their undead!
I know that demons are involved as well, but that doesn't mean anything. Tep could've easily allied with the demons - in fact, that kind of thing is right up his alley!
However, we are scientists and we must always seek irrefutable proof. There's a good number of skeletons out here at the Ruined Shore, so how about you go and get me some bones to study!
Where are the bones I asked for!? If my theory is correct, the bones will belong to Tep cultists. Now, I personally don't doubt myself for a second, but science demands verification!

Let's have a look at these bones. Yep, just as I said! Wait... No, this can't be! These don't belong to Tep cultists, they're missing his mark! Could I have been wrong?! Are you sure you got these off the undead? Hmm, I'm sorry, that was uncalled for. It's just that I didn't expect these bones to completely refute all of my theories!
Explore the 2 Troll Camps and report back to Anfisa Dumina.

All of us here tend to adhere to Nomarkh Nynetjer's theory regarding the Tep cultists. As you can imagine, no one wants to argue with a scholar like him!
There is one issue, however. Cultists typically use bones of the fallen to raise their undead, and we can't figure out where they could've gotten so many bones! Nomarkh thinks that there might be a Zem cemetery somewhere on Coldberg that the cultists have found and are using for materials.
The thing is, we've combed the entire allod and we haven't found any cemeteries yet! There's just one tiny corner that we didn't dare inspect - the troll camp that's to the south of here. Go and take a look around the place. Perhaps you'll find some Zem crypts or monuments.
Nomarkh Nynetjer is awaiting my report! Were you able to find the cemetery?

Remarkable! There isn't a single burial ground anywhere on the allod. If Nomarkh Nynetjer is right and this is all the Tep cultists' doing, then where are they getting the materials?
Sure, they could've taken the miners that died in the attack, but their numbers weren't nearly high enough to create this many undead! I just don't get it. Let's see what Nizamar himself has to say about all this.
Kill 6 Rocky Trolls and Korlok Slobbergut for the Prickle Family.

This allod is home to a savage species of trolls – they're children of the mountains! They were always a nuisance, even before the Astral fangs appeared, but now they've gone completely insane.
There hasn't been one day without a troll attack. They probably think that the allod will disappear soon anyway, so they might as well get their jollies while they're still alive.
And you know, maybe they're right... but their debauchery needs some curbing! Your task is to go kill ten trolls as well as their leader - maybe then we'll have peace.
How's it going with those trolls? We better calm them down as soon as we can. We've already got enough enemies to worry about.

Six trolls are dead? Respect!
Come join our mercenaries! You'll be fighting and getting paid for it! Sounds good, right?
Explore the ship, kill Frostbones and return to Sarang Userkare.

Hello there. I'm Sarang Userkare and I'm here with the Imperial scientists that are investigating this allod.
Now look what I found... It's a Xadaganian ship, and I've been watching it for a while. Hordes of undead are pouring out and moving deeper into the allod. I don't know how many there are in all, but they're headed by this truly abominable skeleton.
I've dubbed him Frostbones. If he's taken out, it may stem the tide of the undead. Please get in there and kill him as soon as possible.

There are more people in this world that are dead than alive. That's how it is and that's how it always will be.
But the undead don't just rise out of their graves on their own - someone is helping them. If we only knew who it was! Anyway, did you make it onto the ship? Has Frostbones been neutralized?

The ship is full of piles of bones? That explains why Coldberg is crawling with the undead. A seasoned necromancer can easily turn those remains into whole armies of the living dead. I wonder where that necromancer is now. Safely holed up somewhere on this allod, I bet. What I wouldn't give to find that scoundrel and flay them alive!
Report to Nomarkh Nynetjer in Coldberg.

I told Nomarkh Nynetjer that his Tep cultists theory is off base! I was the only one who dared to challenge him!
In response he called me an ignoramus, but now he'll have no choice but to admit that I'm right! There are no cultists on Coldberg and there never were! We're dealing with a powerful necromancer that seems to have come here from some Imperial allod.
He or somebody else must have sailed the Xadaganian ship with all the remains to our shores... and that explains the eruption of undead activity. You must tell all of this to Nomarkh Nynetjer! Let's see if he continues to persist with his faulty logic!

A Xadaganian ship full of bones? Looks like I owe an apology to Sarang Userkare. In my defense, most undead activity on other allods has been connected to Tep cultists - and those bastards have been rather active lately... However, we seem to be dealing with a very different enemy here! Which begs the question - who could it possibly be?!
Speak to Sigurd the Swindler in Swindlerville.

Knight Labdanum and I have discovered that the undead appeared after we started sanctifying the Astral fangs and killing demons. Swindler may very well be right in his assumption that the demons and the undead are working together. We're considering every plausible theory at this point, especially since it concerns the mine and meteorite ore. An error may prove too costly, so much so that I'm willing to forget about the doctrines for the moment.
Swindler is requesting aid? Well, then he shall receive it. Go and relay my promise to him!

They've tricked us! I was counting on those League religionists to remain here and fight the undead, but it looks like they're more concerned with the growing schism in their ranks. Now they'll go back home to convene in the Church of Light Council and discuss amendments to the catechism, while I'll be stuck here trying to recapture my mine from the undead on my own.
Well, Strizhov did send us an ark with soil from the ruined League capital. It's supposedly it's his own personal shrine, and Strizhov assures me that it will help us in our struggle. Let's hope he's right!
Speak with Nikolai Strizhov, Timur Belinsky, and Nomarkh Nynetjer about the conspiracy for Sigurd the Swindler.

As I said earlier, after the Astral Fangs and the undead appeared I invited a whole bunch of experts to come help. They managed to deal with the Astral Fangs, but they've been out of action since the demons' invasion... Despite receiving a steady paycheck.
When the allod began to split they all ended up in separate areas. The League clerics ended up in the Snowy Wastes, the Demon Hunters are over at Frost Peak, and the Imperial scientists settled in a spot we've come to call the Ruined Shore. If you ask me, they've been idle long enough!
I'm certain that the demons are executing a coordinated attack on this allod with the undead. Go speak to our experts about this - help them with whatever they need and then come tell me about their findings!
What did my guests say ? Are they finally willing to get their hands dirty and help out? Or will they continue to hide in their respective corners and play the waiting game?

Every one of them is all talk and no action! While you were away I received letters from the Demon Hunters, the Imperial scientists, and the League clerics. And none of them are willing to help drive the undead out of the mine! Of course, everyone's got their own excuse. So I guess we'll have to deal with this problem ourselves!
Use the Charged Shaman's Amulet in the Snowy Wastes, Frost Peak, and the Ruined Shore for Kurgan the Crafty.

These spirit lynx shall be my loyal scouts! I have been preparing for this ritual for a long time and soon I'll be able to do everything by myself. But if you are still willing to help...
Could you go release the lynx spirits on three different points of our allod – the Snowy Wastes, Frost Peak, and the Ruined Shore.
You'll find a shaman statue made of stone in all of those areas and you need to activate my amulet near them. The lynx souls would be able to spy on places that I could only dream of getting! And I'm sure they'll be able to find what I'm looking for!
Just make sure not to lose it! I had this assistant once, he was one of the locals and I entrusted him with my amulet and then he went and exchanged it for a new pair of pants! So I killed him as punishment...
We've waited and toiled for so long! Our hopes were not in vain... Oh... It's you! Never mind, I was just talking to myself! Did you release all the souls where I told you to?

Excellent! Now let's wait for my scouts to return.
I'm actually very nervous. The fate of all shamans - nay, the entire Orcish race - is being decided right here and now. I have a good feeling about this and the dream I had last night was good as well! I was standing before the Great Shaman holding the hand of a beautiful Orcish woman, while a star shone brightly over her head! It must mean good luck!
Test the Protective Artifact when surrounded by Skeletal Lookouts and report back to Timur Belinsky.

We have another development in the fight against demons here. This artifact is made with a meteorite ore base. It is common knowledge that the ore repels anything and everything from the Astral. Try to sneak in and surround yourself with the undead, then turn on the artifact. Hopefully a protective field will envelop it and you.
But make sure to watch the undead carefully! if they are Astral in nature, then they won't be able to breach the field emitted by the artifact!
This artifact is one of our most successful projects. Cutting edge technology in action!

Bah! The artifact should have worked the moment you were close to a single undead if they were related to the demons! It seems that our theories were wrong after all.
So, is this good news or bad news? Well, it definitely can't be good. Your garden variety undead can easily destroy the meteorite ore in the mine, and this ore is the only thing preventing Coldberg from being consumed by the Astral!
Kill the undead that are destroying the meteorite ore in the Broderen Mine.

They all talk big, but when push comes to shove, they buy themselves off with artifacts, potions, and various other devices! What am I supposed to do with all this? I'm a Trader, not a soldier!
But then again, I have you! Take these things and go to the mine - we need to stop the undead before it's too late. Get underground and kill the undead that are destroying my precious meteorite mine!
What happened to the mine? Can we celebrate or should I be packing my bags? If the undead got the best of us, then there's nothing left but to run!

I don't know how to thank you! This ore is not just responsible my own welfare, it's also the only thing preventing our allod from being swallowed up by the Astral. Alas, even I can't afford to keep a Great Mage by my side! If the undead were to destroy the ore, the allod would cease to exist and all its inhabitants would become a demon's dinner!
Deliver the Supreme Chief's letter to Strina the Fierce.

There were times when I doubted that we'd ever find the descendant. We had the City Council impeding our efforts - they were trying to set the rest of the Orcs against us! Sadly, they succeeded - the Orcs turned away from us shamans, regarding us as gossips and troublemakers. But through it all we never gave up, and here it is - our reward! Your task is to find Strina the Fierce in the Broderen Mine. She may have become a prisoner of the undead. Try to find her and give her this letter... It's from Wrokag himself!
Come back to me if you lose your special weapon required to get inside the cave.

When the undead destroy the ore in the mine, Coldberg will vanish into the Astral and I shall sail away on the ship of the dead. I have seen the Truth - Sarnaut must be destroyed! And I am more than capable of making that happen. My power is greater than anything you can imagine, and my demon allies will help me! You think that they are insane, but trust me - you will not find creatures of sounder judgment in all of Sarnaut. Astral demons and the undead stand beside me, but I won't need their help to destroy you! I'd rather not leave any witnesses.
Deliver the Supreme Chief's letter to Strina the Fierce.

There were times when I doubted that we'd ever find the descendant. We had the City Council impeding our efforts - they were trying to set the rest of the Orcs against us! Sadly, they succeeded - the Orcs turned away from us shamans, regarding us as gossips and troublemakers. But through it all we never gave up, and here it is - our reward! Your task is to find Strina the Fierce in the Broderen Mine. She may have become a prisoner of the undead. Try to find her and give her this letter... It's from Wrokag himself!
Come back to me if you lose your special weapon required to get inside the cave.

When the undead destroy the ore in the mine, Coldberg will vanish into the Astral and I shall sail away on the ship of the dead. I have seen the Truth - Sarnaut must be destroyed! And I am more than capable of making that happen. My power is greater than anything you can imagine, and my demon allies will help me! You think that they are insane, but trust me - you will not find creatures of sounder judgment in all of Sarnaut. Astral demons and the undead stand beside me, but I won't need their help to destroy you! I'd rather not leave any witnesses.
Defeat Strina the Fierce and take the Letter Scrap to Kurgan the Crafty.

I see you think I'm insane, but believe me you will not find a person of sounder judgment in all of Sarnaut. My power is greater than anything you can imagine!
Very soon my minions will destroy the meteorite ore in the mine and Coldberg will be doomed! And this is just a test of my powers. They day will soon come when Astral fangs pierce all the allods! Armies of the dead will dance on your graves!
This letter from Wrokag is worthless! I shall tear it to pieces just like I shall tear this whole rotten world apart. And just like I shall tear you apart too!
She said yes, right? She's coming to meet us soon?

What do you mean?! The spirits whispered only good tidings into my ears... The search was over... I was awaiting your return and my heart was singing! I cannot believe this has happened! Woe to the shamans! Woe to all Orcs!
Defeat Strina the Fierce and take the Letter Scrap to Kurgan the Crafty.

I see you think I'm insane, but believe me you will not find a person of sounder judgment in all of Sarnaut. My power is greater than anything you can imagine!
Very soon my minions will destroy the meteorite ore in the mine and Coldberg will be doomed! And this is just a test of my powers. They day will soon come when Astral fangs pierce all the allods! Armies of the dead will dance on your graves!
This letter from Wrokag is worthless! I shall tear it to pieces just like I shall tear this whole rotten world apart. And just like I shall tear you apart too!
She said yes, right? She's coming to meet us soon?

What do you mean?! The spirits whispered only good tidings into my ears... The search was over... I was awaiting your return and my heart was singing! I cannot believe this has happened! Woe to the shamans! Woe to all Orcs!
What are you talking about? She couldn't have betrayed her clan and her people! It simply cannot be! You must be afraid to go under the ground, that's why you're maligning her! Go away from me.
Tell Earka the Nimble about Kurgan's refusal.

There will be no Ritual of Spirit Power! I could easily fool that Orcish mercenary into believing that waving my arms will help, but I just don't want to! My time is too important to waste on her! Her petty problems are nothing compared to the woes of the Orcish shamans!
Tell her to calm down, take a bath, and go find a husband instead! A little bit of fear is nothing to get so worked up about.

Oh those shamans... It's true what they say - they're not Orcs, but shameless jackals! And my dishonor shall remain with me till the end of my days! It doesn't matter that no one knows about it... I know - and that is enough!
What am I to do? This shame can only be cleansed by blood! Aye, that is the only way - I shall go and battle the undead until I am but a pile of bones myself!
Convey Kurgan the Crafty's message to the Gibberlings.

What do you want now? Ah, the Gibberlings' request...
Get out of here! And tell your Gibberlings I'm not helping them. And there's no Ritual of Blood Brotherhood! I lied. Gullible fools usually need to be assured that the Ritual works, but I have no time for practical jokes right now. Everything is lost!
The shamans have no hope, we will be outcasts forever, and the Orcs will never gain independence. Poor Orcs!

The Brotherhood of Blood Ritual is a lie? Impossible! How could one joke about such a thing! I guess our old proverb is right - "a heart is absent in an Orc's chest".
We were really hoping to acquire a brother, but now we've lost all hope. Oh well, now that it's the two of us for good, we'll have to hold on to one another that much tighter!
Thanks for your help. This isn't your fault!
Wait for the Lynx Scouts to return to Kurgan the Crafty.

The spirits that I asked you to release were my scouts. For a long time I've been involved in the search for the last descendant of the Legendary Orc. This is what has brought me to Coldberg. The fate of the entire Orcish race depends on this descendant. He is said to possess great magical talents, powerful enough to keep any allod from being devoured by the Astral - an ability that has kept the Orcs dependent on the Empire to this day.
The shamans will prove to the rest of the Orcs that they were right all along! Look! My scouts are about to return! Let's see what they have to say first, then we'll resume our conversation.
What blessed tidings! Listen, listen to what they're saying! Oh, sorry, I forgot that you don't speak their language!

So much time and effort has been spent on this search! We had lost hope countless times, only to rekindle it time and again! The shamans have found a descendant of the Legendary Orc on Igsh, but they were unable to reach him in time and the descendant died a tragic death. We then found out about Strina the Fierce, a necromancer, but she ran away from us... Wrokag, the Supreme Chief of the Orcs, personally gave me the duty of finding her. And, luckily for us, my spirit scouts report that she is indeed on Coldberg.
You see, now my dream was not a just a dream - it was a prophecy! Fate has chosen me to be the first to discover this great success for the shamans!
Rescue Ironfoot the Dark and report to Sevek the Savage.

Don't just pass by without helping the innocent! You see that filthy Astral fang over there?! Well, I overheard the other mountainfolk talking. They said they were going to sacrifice me in hopes of getting rid of it!
They believe that the fangs and the demons are showing up on Coldberg because of the outsiders defiling their land. And they're talking about everyone - the workers, Sigurd, and you too!
That's all that I could make out while I was eavesdropping... Please, get me out of here and report to Sevek the Savage - he's one of the mercenaries. Maybe he'll finally take matters into his own hands and stop these demons!
They were going to sacrifice their own kind?! Poor soul, he had probably already lost all hope of being rescued! So, what did he say?

That explains it! Those Astral fangs can give just about anyone a healthy scare... The mountainfolk have just gone mad with fear! Explaining anything to them is useless.
Being the ignorant savages that they are, they stick to their primitive customs and taboos. That rules out any possibility for constructive dialog... The only language they understand is that of violence and we've got a message to get across!
Participate in killing Bolbru and report back to Sevek the Savage.

I've just received terrible news! One of those heinous ogres is on a rampage! We have such a mess here right now, there's no way that we can spare any men to go take care of it.
But I know what we can do! I've heard of you before, I know you've got the moxie to take that sucker down.
Bolbru is a ferocious creature and the chief of the ogres. He'll swallow you and your weapon in one gigantic gulp! So it would be wise for you to gather a group.
If you, of all people, cannot defeat Bolbru... Then I'll eat myself in a hamburger!
Bolbru is dead? You have my respect!
Talk to Nomarkh Hanotep to speed up ship's construction.

How should I find a way to thank you... Oh, I know. Would you like to be a captain? The Astral will make you rich pretty fast! I'll just scrawl a few lines to Nomarkh Hanotep to help you build yourself a ship.

Oh, dear Yasker! If it weren't for you, Sigurd would've long been in the grave! And he's paying his debt from the Imperial funds, fancy that! Ah well, there's nothing else to do, but to send extra workers to speed up your ship's construction by 10 days!
Talk to the Glowy Family to speed up ship's construction.

How should I find a way to thank you... Oh, I know. Would you like to be a captain? The Astral will make you rich pretty fast! I'll just scrawl a few lines to the Glowy Family to help you build yourself a ship.

How can he be such a penny pincher! If it weren't for you, Sigurd would've long been in the grave! Ah well, a debt is a debt, there's nothing else to do, but to send extra workers to speed up your ship's construction by 10 days!
Gather 5 Rare Elegant Neckties for Firk the Roughneck in the Historians' Camp.

Listen, I need you to run an errand for me. It's nothing dangerous, it's just... embarrassing. You see, my job is to get all the supplies the Historians need and many of them are Elves.
The Elves around here like to wear things like neckties and, well, think about it! I can't be seen buying something frilly like that! It'd be a great help to me if you could somehow get me the neckties so I can hand them out to the Historians that need them.
Shh! Keep your voice down. Did you get what I asked?
Great! Now maybe they'll get off my back.
Report to Yaver Meryatum at the Historians' Camp that contact has been established with the mainland.

The Historians were founded by the Great Mage Zayan. He is one of the people who devised the method that we use to prevent the allods from being swallowed up by the Astral. This has long been Zayan's home, a place away from his fellow Elves and away from intrigue and wars. It is also a base for the Historians.
Naturally, this is where some of us Elves ran after our trouble with the vampires. Alas, all our hopes were in vain. Immediately after our arrival, an exact copy of the Elven Galleon rammed into the shore. It tried to slice the allod into pieces with some sort of beam.
The allod split into separate isles and the shores were stormed by demons and vampires. We thought we were doomed, but the arrival of your ship has restored contact with the mainland. Now the Historians can be evacuated. Please report your arrival to the others at our main camp.

It's good that we were able to reestablish contact with the other allods. Although, personally I believe that Zayan is strong enough to repel the attack! Funny how fate twists and turns... it was only yesterday that us Historians had smooth sailing.
I told them not to let that conniving rat Gorluxor into our institution! We were doing just fine with Zayan as our lone Great Mage. But did they listen? No! They said "two heads are better than one!" and gave him a seat of honor in accordance with his status.
Who ended up being right? Me, that's who! Gorluxor used the Historians to further his own agenda and in doing so, he ruined things for the rest of us!
Collect 3 drops of Magical Water and 3 Mantis Staves for Yaver Meryatum.

Look at Zayan! Now I get why they call him Zayan the Great... He is holding the beam at bay - I couldn't do that...
Well, there's something else I can do. Great or not, his powers aren't limitless! They must be replenished with magical energy.
Just west of here is Lake Pi'Quea. It means "Toad Lake" in June. Anyway, water elementals currently reside there. Get it?
They are an excellent source of energy! You'll need to collect drops of water from them - that's where power is concentrated. Anyway, don't bother your head about it. Three drops should just about do it.
Wait! That's not all you need to get. In Totnum Forest to the south of here you'll find June ruins. They are inhabited by mantises. We need the wondrous staves that their mages use. The foolish mantises don't feel like helping us willingly, so you'll need to take them by force! Bring me three staves! So will you do these tasks?
If you can help Zayan, our chances for survival will be much higher! Where are the drops and staves I asked for?

Thanks for the drops! When elementals process regular water, it becomes charged with a special energy and thus becomes a magical tonic. It can rejuvenate and revive anyone when taken on an empty stomach! Folk healers traditionally prescribe the water to treat depression.
And here are the wondrous staves! We've spent quite a bit of time studying the mantis' behavioral patterns. They make the staves in the early spring and store them in secret sanctuaries, where the mountain spirits endow the staves with magical energy. Gosh, there I go rambling on about the details again... Anyway, thanks for your help!
Investigate the ruins in the Totnum Forest for Luc de Blizare.

The "Revelation of Tka-Rik" states that the June Great Mages opened gates into another dimension in search of magical energy. Unfortunately for them, behind the gates lurked horrible demons who invaded our world. They obliterated the June before their mages could seal the gates.
Their battles against the demons yielded valuable experience, which may very well prove useful in our own struggle. In the Totnum Forest you'll find some ancient June ruins.
"Totnum" means "massive walls" in June and we suspect the ruins used to be part of a fortress. Not too long ago, the aviaks discovered a strange statue in those ruins, one that could possibly hold military value! Go and study it, but remember that the ruins are home to mantises that aren't very keen on strangers...
The June actually called the demons "curses". You can see this word all over their ruins. Speaking of which, how are the ruins in the south? Did you study them?

Aha! It's just as I thought - this stele is directly correlated to the June military. The artifact you've found is very similar to those that the June used to activate their golems. This means that we better give it a test run!
I don't have to tell you how useful golems would be in our fight against the demons! So many of those beasts have flooded onto the allod it's beginning to look like a third invasion!
As you may know, the seal on the gates was disturbed during the Great Cataclysm, and the Great Astral Campaign was started by Skrakan and Nezeb in an attempt to seal the gates once more. We thought they were sealed for give, but I guess we were wrong!
Anyway, this is no time for history lectures! I must figure out a way to properly test this new artifact you've brought me. Hm... I think I may have an idea.
Investigate the ruins in the Totnum Forest for Luc de Blizare.

Kill 6 Skulking Vampires or Demon Scouts. Report back to Milvus.

Welcome to the allod of Avilon! Or rather, to whatever's left of it. Not long ago this allod was still whole, but the vampire infected Galleon rammed right into it, slicing it into several pieces.
Our tribe has long since been in service to Great Mage Zayan and his Historians. As you can see, we are blessed with the gift of wings. We can fly, wage aerial warfare, and dump all kinds of nasty things on the heads of our enemies. Typically that's enough, but this time, the enemies were too many and we had to assume the defensive.
Half an hour ago our scouts reported a vampire sighting along the eastern shore, not far from here. And five minutes after that, a demon sighting was reported at the northern shore, by the Western Horn. Please help us out by killing ten vampires and ten demon scouts.
How many vampires and demons did you kill? The fewer the number of those animals on our allod, the better!
Thanks for your help. It's obvious that you're no stranger to the art of war. A real Aviak, indeed!
Collect 2 samples of Mantis Blood, 2 samples of Squirrel Blood, and 2 samples of Toad Blood. Bring them to Roxane de Doucer in the Historians' Camp.

This citadel looks like an exact replica of the Galleon that my father, Armando de Doucer, took from the House de Desirae. It reminds me of the disgrace suffered by my House.
My father craved power and immortality, so much so that he cooperated with the forces of evil and became a vampire. Then he infected the other members of our House! I was one of the only ones that escaped, and I am fortunate to not share their wicked fate.
Since then I've devoted my life to becoming an expert on vampirism. You may already know that virtually any creature can be made into a vampire, and I want to make sure that the epidemic isn't already spreading throughout the allod.
I need blood samples from toads, mantises, and squirrels. Three samples of blood from each animal should do. Please, bring them to me as quickly as possible! They all leave nearby at Lake Pi'Quea or Totnum Forest.
I feel bad about those toads and squirrels, but it's best that we tend to our own safety. Where are the blood samples I asked for?

Hand them over, I'll run a quick check.
Fortunately, none of the local residents have been stricken with vampirism so far, but we shouldn't relax just yet.
Even though father is no longer among us, I feel as though his voice still resounds inside my head. He calls me a traitor and implores me to join him. The Aviaks say that all the vampires on the shards look like Elves... I shudder to think what that might mean for the rest of us.
Report on your findings to Luc de Blizare at the Historians' Camp.

These are remains of demons and... Ugh, what disgusting creature! It's as though its face has been devoured by worms. I wonder what really happened here! It looks like the wormfaced creature battled with demons and managed to slay a few before going down himself.
Archivist Luc de Blizare should be notified.

A creature with a worm-like face. Shall we call it a wormface? So be it.
But what kind of beast is this and where did it come from? I've never heard of these creatures before... No one has!
Tell Milvus about the vampire attack on the Aviak Village.

I'm on my way to the Historians' camp to bring them news from the Aviaks.
Tidings are dire as ever – we have been attacked by the vampires once again and are barely holding them off. The bastards crave blood so much that they practically ignore our weapons, even as they cut through them!
They caught up to me here on the shore... I was able to fight them off, but they wounded me. Don't worry, it wasn't a bite, so I won't be turning into a vampire just yet. But I am too exhausted to keep going! Hurry to the Historians' camp and tell Milvus about the vampire attack.

What was there? Tell me!
...I knew it! If I could, I'd rush over to help my tribe...
